intro.title: Production Node.js
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple, production-ready Node.js server that handles HTTP requests and logs important events. You'll learn the core concept of structuring a Node.js application for reliability and monitoring in a live environment. The main technologies involved include the built-in 'http' module for creating a server, the 'fs' module for file operations, and environment variables for configuration. By the end, you'll understand how to set up a basic production server with error handling and logging to prepare your Node.js apps for real-world use.
intro.usecase: Production Node.js skills are essential for building scalable backend services that power real-world applications like e-commerce platforms, social media APIs, and financial systems. Developers use these techniques to create robust RESTful APIs that handle thousands of concurrent requests, such as payment processing endpoints for online stores or real-time chat servers. These production-ready patterns ensure applications remain performant during traffic spikes, maintain data integrity with proper error handling, and provide reliable uptime through health monitoring and logging. Mastering these concepts allows you to deploy Node.js applications that can scale from small startups to enterprise-level systems.
